dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。はじめに年齢、性別、相談したい内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Good evening, this is the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 30代、女性
dialogue.content: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.origin: 旦那の実家と付き合うのがつらいです
dialogue.content: I'm having a hard time dealing with my husband's family.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。旦那様のご両親との関係についてお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are you struggling with your relationship with your husband's parents?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 例えばどのような時に辛いと感じますか？
dialogue.content: For example, when do you feel it's difficult?

dialogue.origin: 会うのも嫌です
dialogue.content: I don't even want to meet them.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。会うのがつらいと思うほど悩まれているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you're struggling so much that even meeting them feels painful.

dialogue.origin: 旦那様にはご相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever discussed this with your husband?

dialogue.origin: 相談はしましたが、いざというときは助けてくれません
dialogue.content: I have, but when it comes down to it, he doesn't help me.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。差支えなければ旦那様にどのような相談をしたのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see. If you don't mind, could you tell me what you discussed with your husband?

dialogue.origin: 仕事を辞めたくないことを説明して、「わかった」と言ってくれていました。
dialogue.content: I explained that I didn't want to quit my job, and he told me he understood.

dialogue.origin: でも、両親から「長男の嫁は家に入らないといけない」と言われて。
dialogue.content: But then his parents told me, 'The eldest son's wife must stay at home.'

dialogue.origin: そのときは、何も旦那は言ってくれず
dialogue.content: At that time, my husband didn't say anything.

dialogue.origin: ずっと両親から言われました
dialogue.content: His parents just kept telling me that.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: I see, that's what happened. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: お二人で話されたときは辞めなくてもいいと言ってくれたのにも関わらず、ご両親の前ではあなた様を助けてくれなかったのはとても悲しかったことと感じました。
dialogue.content: It sounds like it must have been very sad for you when he didn't support you in front of his parents, especially after he had told you that you didn't have to quit your job when you spoke privately.

dialogue.origin: 旦那様はご両親にご自分の意見を伝えることが難しいのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it perhaps difficult for your husband to express his own opinions to his parents?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いざという時は助けてくれないんだと思いました
dialogue.content: I realized he wouldn't help me when it really mattered.

dialogue.origin: 旦那はあまり両親には言えないと思います
dialogue.content: I don't think my husband can really say much to his parents.

dialogue.origin: 助けてもらいたい時に手を差し伸べてもらえないのはとても辛いお気持ちになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: It must be very painful not to have a helping hand extended when you need it most.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなた様はご両親に仕事を続けることを理解してもらいたいということが、今の強いお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is your strongest feeling right now that you want his parents to understand that you want to continue working?

dialogue.origin: 仕事もですが、私の意見も聞いてほしいです
dialogue.content: It's not just about my job; I also want them to listen to my opinion.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。あなた様のお話に耳を傾け、寄り添ってほしいというお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you feel that you want them to listen to what you have to say and be supportive?

dialogue.origin: 寄り添わなくてもいいですが
dialogue.content: They don't have to be supportive, but...

dialogue.origin: 私の意見も聞いてほしい
dialogue.content: I just want them to listen to my opinion.

dialogue.origin: 仕事も実家近くで、勝手に探したり
dialogue.content: They even looked for a job for me near their house without asking.

dialogue.origin: 結婚式を勝手に取り止めたり
dialogue.content: They canceled the wedding without consulting us.

dialogue.origin: 何の相談なく決められます
dialogue.content: They make these decisions without any consultation.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことがあったのですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。とても大事なことを当事者に相談なく決めてしまうのは・・・あまりに勝手であるように感じました。
dialogue.content: So those things happened... Thank you for sharing. It seems incredibly selfish to make such important decisions without consulting the person involved.

dialogue.origin: 旦那様はご両親のそのような行動に対して何も意見をおっしゃらないのですか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband not say anything to his parents about their behavior?

dialogue.origin: 結婚式のキャンセルの時は、このままだったら結婚破棄すると言ったので、なんとか親戚と協力して両親を説得したみたいです
dialogue.content: When they canceled the wedding, I told him I would break off the engagement if things continued like that, so he somehow managed to persuade his parents with the help of other relatives.

dialogue.origin: 私の親もバカにしてると怒ってました
dialogue.content: My parents were also angry, saying they were being disrespected.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。あなた様はその時の旦那様の行動をどのように感じましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. How did you feel about your husband's actions at that time?

dialogue.origin: 頼りないです
dialogue.content: He's unreliable.

dialogue.origin: もうあきらめてます
dialogue.content: I've already given up on him.

dialogue.origin: あなた様のお悩みを旦那様以外の方にご相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you discussed your concerns with anyone other than your husband?

dialogue.origin: 自分の親にも相談しています
dialogue.content: I've talked to my own parents about it.

dialogue.origin: ご両親はどのようにおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.content: What do your parents say?

dialogue.origin: 母と祖母は旦那にしっかり言ってくれました。
dialogue.content: My mother and grandmother gave my husband a firm talking-to.

dialogue.origin: しかし、女性だからか母から言われても旦那はあまり気にしてないみたいです
dialogue.content: However, maybe because it came from my mother, a woman, my husband doesn't seem to take it very seriously.

dialogue.origin: あなた様は旦那様に本当はどのようになってもらいたいとお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How do you truly want your husband to be?

dialogue.origin: 私の味方になってほしい
dialogue.content: I want him to be on my side.

dialogue.origin: 一番近くにいる旦那様に味方になってほしいというお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you want your husband, the person closest to you, to be on your side?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、最後はきっと両親の味方なんだろうって
dialogue.content: But I feel like in the end, he'll probably side with his parents.

dialogue.origin: 思ってしまいます
dialogue.content: I can't help but think that.

dialogue.origin: 私は1人だなって
dialogue.content: I feel like I'm all alone.

dialogue.origin: これまでたくさん悩まれてきたことと思います。何度も裏切られてしまうとそれがずっと心にひっかかり、あきらめてしまうお気持ちになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: I imagine you've been through a lot. When you feel betrayed repeatedly, it's natural for that to linger in your heart and make you want to give up.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 期待しても、裏切られて
dialogue.content: I get my hopes up, and then I'm let down.

dialogue.origin: 期待しないといいのに、また期待してしまいます
dialogue.content: I know I shouldn't expect anything, but I can't help hoping again.

dialogue.origin: 先ほどの結婚式をご親戚と一緒に説得したというお話を伺った時、旦那様はあなた様と一緒になりたいからこそ、ご両親に自分の気持ちをぶつけたのだと感じました。
dialogue.content: When I heard about how he worked with your relatives to persuade his parents regarding the wedding, I felt that he confronted his parents with his feelings precisely because he wanted to be with you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: きっとあなた様も、旦那様に気づいてほしい、助けてほしいというお気持ちがあるからこそ、どこかで期待をしているのだと感じました。
dialogue.content: And I feel that you still have some hope because, deep down, you want your husband to notice and to help you.

dialogue.origin: もう一度、旦那様にあなた様の素直なお気持ちを伝えてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How about trying to express your true feelings to your husband one more time?

dialogue.origin: 旦那様もどのようにしてあなた様を守ることができるのか、本当はお互いに悩んでいるのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Perhaps your husband is also struggling with how to protect you, and you're both unsure of what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 一度話をしてみようと思います
dialogue.content: I'll try talking to him once.

dialogue.origin: はい。是非今の一番の願いを素直に伝えてみてください。あなた様のお気持ちが旦那様に伝わることを心より願っています。
dialogue.content: Yes. Please do try to convey your most important wish honestly. I sincerely hope your feelings reach your husband.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 少し主人の気持ちも考えてみようと思います
dialogue.content: I think I'll try to consider my husband's feelings a little more, too.

dialogue.origin: 結婚したいと願った相手です。あなた様のお気持ちが伝わることを願っています。
dialogue.content: He is the person you wished to marry. I hope your feelings will reach him.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 本日はお話しくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for speaking with me today.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日は以上とさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Then, that will be all for today.

dialogue.origin: お世話になりました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.origin: (お疲れさまでした。本日はありがとうございました。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time today. I appreciate it.)

topic.sub: 旦那の両親との関係問題
